source_status: teaching notes (TVZ, Zagreb) reproducing Viadukt d.d. SAN type girders; not a producer catalogue

source.figure: Slika 2.5 - Tipski montažni nosači (scanned bitmap, ~300 dpi)

text_original: Rješenje koje se danas primjenjuje predstavljaju tipski armiranobetonski ili prednapeti betonski nosači koje tvrtka Viadukt proizvodi u pet različitih poprečnih presjeka ovisno o rasponu i zadanom opterećenju (slika 2.5). ... Ako su šupljine u montažnim elementima okruglog presjeka, ploče se grade kao slobodne grede raspona do 20 m, a ako su šupljine četvrtastog presjeka, rasponi mogu biti i oko 30 m

SAN 210/75.scaled: diameters 50.2-51.9 (line centres), centres at -59.6/-1.0/+59.4, top cover ~15, bottom ~8 at 1.93 px/cm; rounded to the 15/10 slab convention of the larger types

all.scaled: side groove (half of the longitudinal 'moždanik' joint) 13-35 cm below top on 210/75, 15 cm tall ~25 cm below top on 210/115 and 210/135, ~2.5-4 cm deep

skipped: The text says Viadukt produced five cross-sections; only three are drawn in Slika 2.5.
geometry_notes: Overall 210 x H and (115/135) slab/web thicknesses 15/10/15 are printed; the drawing is to scale within ~1.5 cm (line-centre measurements), confirming the reading.
SAN 210/75 void diameter and positions are not dimensioned: scaled, then rounded to O50 at 60 cm centres, centre 35 cm above the soffit (10 cm bottom / 15 cm top cover): estimate.
SAN 210/115 and 210/135 octagonal voids: 15 x 15 cm corner chamfers scaled from the drawing (estimate).

Both vertical faces carry a shallow groove forming the longitudinal shear-key joint; modelled as a trapezoidal notch 3 cm deep, 15 cm tall (9 cm flat), centred 25 cm below the top: estimate. Top and bottom outer corners square as drawn.
